faq: Will edits disappear when the theme updates?
Not if we use a child theme, which is what we do. Your changes sit in their own folder, so the parent theme can update without wiping your work.
Which themes do you work with?
Most popular themes and page builders, including block themes, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, Divi and Elementor. If your theme is unusual, send a link and we confirm before quoting.
Do you edit my live site directly?
We prefer a staging copy so visitors never see half-finished work. If your host has no staging, we make a backup first and keep any live changes small.
What if I do not know what is wrong?
Send screenshots, page links and a few words on what looks off. We turn that into a clear fix list for you to approve before we start.
desc:
Small theme problems tend to stay on a site for years because editing the theme directly feels risky. Ecom Swift LLC handles WordPress theme customization and edits safely, using a child theme and a staging copy before anything goes live.

## What is WordPress theme customization?

Theme customization is changing how your existing WordPress theme looks or behaves: layouts, spacing, fonts, headers, footers, page templates and styles. It is different from replacing the theme, because your content and structure stay as they are.

The safe method uses a child theme, a small companion theme that holds your changes. The parent theme can then receive updates without wiping your work.

## Why edit safely

Many owners learn the hard way that edits made directly in a theme disappear on the next update. A heading style they fixed last month returns, a custom footer vanishes, and nobody remembers what was changed. Others paste code from a forum into the live site, and a typo takes the whole page down.

A careful process avoids both problems. Changes live in one place, are tested before they reach visitors and are written down, so the next person who touches the site can follow them.

## How theme work affects your site

The effect is on usability and consistency. A header that wraps badly on a phone, a button that looks different on each page or a template that does not show a key section all create small moments of doubt. Fixing them makes the site look cared for, and makes it easier to use.

Templates save time for your team. A reusable layout for a service, a landing page or a team member means new pages match the old ones with no extra effort. Results depend on how well the changes serve your visitors, so we focus on clear, small improvements.

## What good theme edits include

- A child theme created if you do not have one.
- Layout fixes for spacing, alignment and broken sections.
- Style changes that follow one set of colors and fonts.
- New page templates for content types such as services or landing pages.
- A redesigned header or footer that works on phones.
- Custom blocks or sections that editors can reuse.
- Removal of unused styles that slow the site.
- Checks in several browsers and on desktop and phone.
- A staging test before the live change.
- Notes that list what changed and where.

## How we work

You send a list of what looks wrong or what you want added, with screenshots if you can. If you are not sure what is wrong, we find the cause. We then set up the child theme, make the edits on a staging copy and test them on desktop and phone.

When you are happy, we apply the same changes to the live site. Basic handles a short list of visual fixes. Standard adds a new template and a header or footer redesign. Premium covers several templates, custom blocks and a tidier theme that is easy to maintain. Add-ons include an extra template, a custom icon set and a print stylesheet.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send screenshots with the page address for each issue.
- Say which devices and browsers matter to your visitors.
- Keep your theme and plugins updated after the work.
- Ask for notes on every change.
- Group related requests together.

**Avoid:**
- Editing theme files from the dashboard editor on a live site.
- Pasting unchecked code from random sources.
- Making large changes without a backup.
- Mixing page builder styles with hand-written code without a plan.
- Leaving old styles in place that no page uses.

## Who it is for

Owners with a theme that is nearly right but has a few stubborn problems can have them solved quickly. Businesses that need a new page layout, such as a service page that differs from the rest, can add one without a rebuild. Agencies that inherited a messy theme can use it to bring order.

## How to get started

Tell us the theme you use, list the changes you want and share the page addresses. We never ask for passwords. We work through an administrator or collaborator user, and we make a backup before we begin. Tell us if the theme was already modified, so we do not overwrite earlier work.
